description: Fix 3 blocking issues from P1-P4 audit before starting P5 input pipeline
acceptance_criteria: AC1: ProblemExtractor.from_jira_issue() populates extracted_files with file paths found via regex in title+description (e.g., Foo.java, path/to/Bar.scala)
AC2: ProblemExtractor.from_jira_issue() populates extracted_symbols with CamelCase class/method names from title+description
AC3: ProblemExtractor.from_jira_issue() populates extracted_keywords with lowercase title words filtered through stopwords
AC4: ProblemExtractor.from_raw() populates all three fields identically to from_jira_issue()
AC5: Unit tests cover Level 1 extraction with committed fixtures at tests/fixtures/eval_case_text/{CASSANDRA-7570,SPARK-19033,GROOVY-8298}.json containing title/description/project/issue_key

AC6: recall@100 validation test runs retrieve_candidates() on >= 3 eval cases from manifest.json with real cloned repos at data/repos/, using GitContextProvider(..., temporal_bound=manifest temporal_bound)
AC7: recall@100 test asserts CASSANDRA-7570 found=True with len(strategies_that_found) > 0 and fallback_triggered=False when repo exists; other cases assert at least 1 finds ground truth

AC8: tests/test_v4_integration.py chains ProblemStatement (with populated signals from extraction) → retrieve_candidates (mock GitContextProvider keyed on problem.extracted_files/keywords/symbols) → assemble_prompt for all 3 stages
AC9: Integration test asserts no TypeErrors, non-empty prompt strings, len(candidate_set.commits) >= 1, correct section count per stage
AC11: ProblemStatement.to_prompt_text() has deprecation docstring naming PromptAssembler/assemble_prompt as replacement
AC12: Integration test sets InvestigationState.candidates_total = len(candidate_set.commits) with documenting comment
AC13: All existing 291 tests continue to pass with zero regressions
AC14: New tests bring total test count above 291
edge_cases: EC1: Title-only JIRA (empty description) — extraction still produces keywords from title
EC2: Description with no file paths — extracted_files is empty list, not error
EC3: Unicode in description — regex doesn't crash
EC4: recall@100 test skips gracefully if repo not cloned (pytest.mark.skipif) — except CASSANDRA-7570 which is mandatory when repo present
EC5: Integration test works without real git repos (mock GitContextProvider)
EC6: Extraction handles None description from JIRA
EC7: AC5 extraction tests always run (no skip); recall tests skip only when repo absent
verification_method: pytest sensors (all tests pass, no regressions) + /evaluator adversarial review
